patch_description:
The current model is severely over-regularized (reg_lambda=0.8, lr=0.015) which causes prediction collapse. Prior experiments show that models with reg_lambda=0.05-0.15 and lr=0.05-0.10 achieve better val_DA (0.52-0.53). 

I will:
1. Increase learning_rate from 0.015 to 0.08 (closest to best historical performance)
2. Reduce reg_lambda from 0.8 to 0.12 (balanced regularization)
3. Reduce min_child_weight from 5 to 2 (allow more flexible tree fitting)
4. Reduce n_estimators from 1400 to 900 (avoid overfitting with lighter trees)
5. Curate features: Remove redundant lagged features (ret_1_lag1, ret_1_lag2, obi_lag1, funding_lag1) and low-signal skew feature. Keep only essential interaction and regime features.
6. Keep max_depth=6 (good balance) and increase subsample/colsample to 0.9 (regularize via sampling, not via penalty)

This mirrors the best-performing prior config (score -0.20) which had val_DA=0.5226 and pred_std_ratio=0.0607.
